title: feat: persist advanced arena artifacts and tournament outcomes
body:
## P4 follow-up — Advanced Arena persistence

Stacked after PR #22 (`completion/desktop-delivery`); PRs #17–#22 remain draft.

- adds immutable app-owned calibration benchmark/result and tournament-result storage with migration, typed commands, provenance hashes, and fail-closed source validation
- freezes AI-judge identity/version/rubric/prompt metadata and validates official 3- or 5-judge panels without network calls or silent substitution
- resolves tournament outcomes/standings from immutable Arena evidence and exposes persisted save/reopen/disagreement UI
- keeps objective verifier authority, blind evidence boundaries, and deterministic insufficient-data/tie handling
- validated by canonical BL4 app_server: 79 TypeScript tests, 100 Rust tests, typecheck, Vite build, cargo fmt/check, and diff checks

P4 remains IN PROGRESS pending real native Tauri acceptance, official benchmark-version judge integration, and remaining publication/security gates.

No merge, tag, release, deploy, or public release is included.
